name: Help
description: byob's own user guide for the model: the byob_help tool looks up installing byob, connecting a model, settings, workspaces and plugins (mail, calendar, environments, writing plugins) in the docs that ship with byob. Read-only and local.
prompt: For questions about byob itself (installing it, connecting a model, its settings, workspaces, plugins such as mail and calendar, writing plugins), look it up with byob_help before answering and give the user the steps from it; don't guess at byob's settings.

tools.name: byob_help
tools.title: Read byob's help
tools.description: byob's user guide. No arguments: the topics. topic: read one (long ones come in parts: section, a name or number, or start). query: the best-matching sections across all topics, e.g. "gmail app password".

query.description: Keywords to search every topic for.

topic.description: A topic name from the list, e.g. "mail".

section.description: With topic: one section, by its heading or number.

start.description: With topic: character offset to read on from.
